assertions.assertion: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome
as documented in the clinical indication note
To further characterize the underlying cardiac arrhythmia and correlate these symptoms with rhythm disturbances
a 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation
This diagnostic service is medically necessary to support the diagnoses of I49.5, I49.9, and R00.2
given the documented cardiac symptoms requiring correlation of palpitations and bradycardia with rhythm abnormalities
